response.close_all: Flatten every layer immediately if account equity drops to 8,500 (collateral 2,500 fully consumed plus 1,000 cushion, i.e. the 'royal army' is threatened), or if BTC prints a daily close below 76,000 or above 88,000 (range regime dead, Dynamic flow has changed and the range tactic no longer has an edge). Also flatten all at week end if total realized+unrealized is positive by more than 4% of collateral (+100 USD): bank the hostages, redesign RP next week. Otherwise no forced liquidation; hostages are held into next week under the same RP.
response.hostage_policy: Four armies, each 2,500 notional (4x of 2,500 collateral, 25% of collateral at risk per layer at the 25% hard stop). Fixed RP: never add size to a losing layer, never martingale, never tighten the stop to free margin. A layer that goes against us is a hostage, not a loss: keep it, stop entering that symbol in the same direction, and hunt with the remaining armies (prefer the uncorrelated side: if BTC long is hostage, look for ETH/SOL short rallies). Realized wins are first used to release a hostage when win + hostage loss >= 0 (path D in the article); if the hostage recovers to flat or better, release it at breakeven+ and re-enter only at a fresh zone. Max 2 hostages at once; if 2 layers are underwater, stop all new entries and wait & see until one is released. Profits above 2,500 collateral stay in the main port as buffer this week; no Step 2 Big-Win bets until buffer exceeds 10% of collateral.

Following the Hostage Hunt design: Control Risk (4x total, 25%-of-collateral hard stop per layer, close-all at 8,500 equity), Limit Resources (4 fixed 2,500 layers, one per symbol, max 2 hostages), Wait & See (entries only at range edges with 4h confirmation, no mid-range trades). Goal this week is Step 1 only: survive and accumulate +1.5% to +4% hostages per layer rather than predict the breakout.

response.close_all: Flatten every layer immediately if account equity (free equity + collateral + unrealized) drops to 8,500, which is the royal-army floor (15% of the original 10,000; current equity is about 9,420 after last week's SOL stop-out, so this still leaves roughly 900 of cushion). Also flatten all if BTC prints a daily close below 74,500 (the weekly swing-low region and the lower-box tactic is dead) or a daily close above 84,000 (back above the old box, trend regime, range edges no longer have an edge). Otherwise no forced liquidation: at week end, if total realized+unrealized for the week is positive by more than +100 USD (4% of collateral), close all winners to bank the hostages and redesign RP next week; hostages (layers still underwater within the 25% RP stop) may be carried into next week under the same RP.
response.hostage_policy: Four armies, fixed RP each: 2,500 collateral, 10,000 notional (4x, within max leverage 10-40 of every watchlist symbol), 25% of collateral (~625 USD, about 6.25% price) as the only hard stop. Never add size to a losing layer, never martingale, never tighten a stop to free margin, never hedge the same symbol. A layer that goes against us is a hostage, not a loss: keep it, stop entering that symbol in the same direction, and hunt with the remaining armies, preferring the opposite side of a different symbol (BNB long is the current hostage, so lean on BTC/ETH shorts into resistance or SOL/XRP longs at box floors depending on which edge prints). Realized wins are used first to release a hostage when win + hostage loss >= 0 (path D from the article); if the hostage recovers to breakeven+fees while slots are needed, release it and re-enter only at a fresh zone. Max 2 hostages at once: with BNB already underwater, only one more layer may become a hostage; if 2 layers are underwater, stop all new entries and wait & see until one is released. After last week's SOL stop-out, re-entry into any symbol that hit its 25% RP stop requires a 4h reclaim plus BTC daily above 76,000. Profits above collateral stay in the main port as buffer; no Step 2 Big-Win bets until buffer exceeds 10% of collateral (+250), which is not the case this week.

Notional stays 10,000 against RP collateral 2,500 since no reallocation happens; 4x is within every watchlist symbol's max leverage (BNB 10 is the lowest).
